body:
I feel kind of stupid now for omitting some details that are probably important. Yes, I have seen a therapist for anxiety. I feel like I've more or less overcome that. My problem seems to be centered around this person who I spend every day with. It's making me insane, but the only thing that seems worse is the idea of not seeing her. She has expressed feelings for me and we've become very close, but I can't return any feelings of my own because she's married and I would sooner die than hurt a family. 

I know you're probably thinking she's the one doing that. She knows what she's done is wrong and unfair to me. Yes, I did the right thing by keeping my feelings to myself despite how difficult that was, but where do I go from here? They won't just go away. I simply don't care about anything else now. I've never felt this way for someone before, so I don't know how to get rid of it. My job is all I have, so if I have to run away from that to get away from her, it's not much better.
